full_judgment: 2. The facts leading to the issuance of the Rule, in short, is that the present sole opposite party Sree Trinoyan Chakma as plaintiff had filed the Title Suit No.54 of 2009 in the Court of Joint District Judge, Rangamati against the defendant Satyabrata Chakma who is the petitioner now for Specific Performance of a Contract averring inter-alia that defendant proposed to sell 0.05 acres of land described in the schedule of the plaint and the plaintiff agreed with purchase the same at a consideration of taka 3,50,000/-. Pursuant to the on gong Rule of Hill District area the defendant applied to the Deputy Commissioner, Rangamati (in short the D.C. Rangmati) for obtaining permission as such Mutation Case No.80 (U, Bhumi)/2007(sadar-102) was started whereupon the Assistant Commissioner of Land (in short the A/C land) asked the Kanungo to investigate into the matter who submitted a report with a sketch map and after hearing both the parties the A/C land forwarded the matter to the Additional Deputy Commissioner, Revenue (in short the ADC) with a recommendation for granting sale permission and ultimately the ADC Revenue approved the proposal and sent the record to Rangamati Zilla Parishad who also recommended the proposal for sale on 16.10.2007 and ultimately the matter was transmitted to the D.C., Rangamati who passed an final order on 18.10.2007 mutating the name of the plaintiff purchaser and on 26.12.2007 a kabala deed in respect of schedule land was registered and accordingly holding No.23/kha and mutated khatian no.623/ka was opened but the possession of the land was not delivered in favour of the plaintiff within more than one year. Thus the plaintiff has been constrained to file the suit for Specific Performance of a Contract.
